A-mante, Jr.: This rerers to your letter seeking an opinion on whether the City of Butuan can use the Public-Private Partnership (competitive challenge / unsolicited proposal for joint ventures) through its own PPP Code to undertake the dredging project as a measure for disaster risk reduction and mitigation. Your query is in relation to the plan of the City of Butuan to rehabilitate and restore the navigability of Agusan River through the conduct of dredging as a measure of disaster risk reduction and climate change adaptation. In your letter, you mentioned that the City of Butuan has experienced catastrophes that caused it a number of times to declare a state of calamity and suffer losses and sizable resources Ai,ended for each catastrophe. resort to PPP is being contemplated on account of financial constraints and Ale cost of dredging, a task that the City of Butuan cannot accomplish by itself the cons using oniy its own resources. Fucther, you mentioned that there have been expressions of interest from private companies to undertake the dredging project through PPP, particularly through unsolicited proposals for joint ventures (JV), and that under the city's own PPP Code, joint ventures selection/bidding, or either through competitive selection/bidding or competitive competitive challenge / unsolicited proposals are expressly allowed. By way of comment, it is viewed that undertaking the dredging project via PPP is a legal and viable mode provided under the City of Butuan's PPP Code, a legal framework for under-a king these kind of projects with private sector partners. a PPP Code is one thing, and delivering and implementing an actual PPP other thing. Recognizing the vast potential of PPP as a globally recognized project delivering strategic, new, and improved infrastructure facilities intended to modalit

address the fundamental necessities of the people within •an LGUs' jurisdiction, this - Administration officially launched the country's PPP program in 2010. Since then, the PPP Center, formerly the Build Operate ransfer (BOT) Center attached to the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), is now attached agency under the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA)..I Under the Aquino Presidency, the PPP Program is a cornerstone strategy for national development aimed at accelerating infrastructure and other development services, in order to sustain national economic growth.2 To date, however, there is no specific statute on PPP nor guidelines on joint ventures (J V) for local govern_ments. The Revised Guidelines And Procedures For Entering Into Joint Venture (JV) Agreements Between Government And Private Entities] issued by NEDA excludes the local government units from the coverage. Thus, the City of Butuan's PPP Code, being a duly enacted local legislation, must be complied with in undertaking its PPP projects. However, whenever applicable, the NEDA Revised JV Guidelines and the BOT law'l and its revised implementing rules and regulations, may be referred to. We further note that PPP infrastructure or development projects are excluded from the appliéation cf the implementing rules and regulations of RA 9184 or the Government Procurement Fee-corm Act, save for the portions financed by the Government of the Philippines. 5 In pua-suing the proposed JV with a private sector, the (fy is not precluded from seeking assistance from either the PPP Center or any competent independent consultant/s from the private sector in undertaking the proposed joint venture project. It may interest the City of Butuan that the PPP Center provides technical assistance to national government agencies (NGAs), government-oWned-and controlled corporations (GOCCs), state universities and colleges (SUCs), and local government agencies (LGUs) as well as to the p;ivate sector to help develop and implement critical infrastructure and other developmeut rojects.6 The City of Butuan's intended dredging project is deemed an appropriate and critical infrastructure project that is aimed to address the city's capacity to prepare, mitigate, and manage the of any disaster. Such project is gargantuan in tepns of cause and cost, and it is only that the City of Butuan be properly guided in the process of initiating, implementing, and sustaining the project eventually. The PPP Center continuously banks on building technical capacities of LGUs starting from the selection, preparation, implementation up to the monitoring and evaluation of local PPPs7 and the City of Butuan, at its option, may appropriately avail of the services of Vhe PPP Center, to undertake the dredging of the Agusan River vra PPP mode.
